My maize plot is very small, only 0.07 hectares near the house, but maize is what feeds my family so I must take care of it. I will try to buy a small bag of fertilizer through the government subsidy if I can get a coupon, and I save manure from my goats to mix in because fertilizer alone is too expensive. I planted hybrid seed last year and it did better than the local one, so I will buy a small packet again and intercrop with pigeon peas and pumpkins like I always do. I cannot irrigate — I depend on the rains — and I will do most of the work myself with help from my children, only hiring a little labor for ridging if my back is tired.
